toc.title: Nashir Ki Taraf Se Kuchh Aham Baatein

sections.title: Nashir Ki Taraf Se Kuchh Aham Baatein

blocks.text:
Nashir Ki Taraf Se Kuchh Aham
               Baatein
  Mukhtalaf Mamalik Se Kai Likhne Waale
Humein Apna Sarmaya Irsaal Farma Rahe Hain
Jinhein Hum Shaya Kar Rahe Hain, Hum Ye
Batana  Zaroori Samajhte Hain Ke Humari
Shaya Karda Kitabo Ke Mundarijaat (Contents)
Ki Zimmedari Hum Is Hadd Tak Lete Hain Ke
Ye Sab Ahle Sunnat Wa Jama'at Se Hai Aur Ye
Zaahir Bhi Hai Ke Har Likhari Ka Talluq Ahle
Sunnat Se Hai, Dusri Janib Akabireene Ahle
Sunnat Ki Jo Kitabein Shaya Ki Ja Rahi Hain
To Un Ke Mutalliq Kuchh Kehne Ki Haajat Hi
Nahin Phir Baat Aati Hai Lafzi Aur Imlai
Ghalatiyo Ki To Jo Kitabein "Team Abde
Mustafa Official" Ki Peshkash Hoti Hain Unke
Liye Hum Zimmedar Hain Aur Wo Kitabein Jo
Mukhtalaf Zaraaye Se Humein Mausool Hoti
Hain, Un Mein  Is Tarah Ki Ghalatiyo Ke
Hawale Se Hum Bari Hain Ke Wahan Hum Har
Har Lafz Ki Chhan Phatak Nahin Karte Aur
Humara Kirdaar Bas Ek Nashir Ka Hota Hai
  Ye Bhi Mumkin Hai Ke Kai Kitabo Mein
Aisi Baatein Bhi Ho'n Ke Jin Se Hum Ittefaq
                   3

Achhi Betiya’n
Nahin Rakhte, Misaal Ke Taur Par Kisi Kitab
Mein Koi Aisi Riwayat Bhi Ho Sakti Hai Ke
Tehqeeq Se Jis Ka Jhoota Hona Ab Saabit Ho
Chuka Hai Lekin Use Likhne Waale Ne Adame
Tawajjo Ki Bina Par Naqal Kar Diya Ya Kisi
Aur Wajah Se Wo Kitab Mein Aa Gai Jaisa Ke
Ahle Ilm Par Makhfi Nahin Ke Kai Wujoohaat
Ki Bina Par Aisa Hota Hai, To Jaisa Humne Arz
Kiya Ke Agarche Use Hum Shaya Karte Hain
Lekin Isse Ye Na Samjha Jaaye Ke Hum Usse
Ittefaq Bhi Karte Hain
  Ek Misaal Aur Hum Ahle Sunnat Ke Mabain
Ikhtelafi Masail Ki Pesh Karna Chahte Hain Ke
Kai Masail Aise Hain Jin Mein Ulama -e- Ahle
Sunnat Ka Ikhtelaf Hai Aur Kisi Ek Amal Ko
Koi Haraam Kehta Hai To Dusra Uske Jawaz
Ka Qaail Hai, Aise Mein Jab Hum Ek Nashir Ka
Kirdaar Ada Kar Rahe Hain To Dono Ki Kitabo
Ko Shaya Karna Humara Kaam Hai Lekin
Humara Mauqif Kya Hai, Ye Ek Alag Baat Hai,
Hum Fareeqain Ki Kitabo Ko Is Bunyad Par
Shaya Kar Sakte Hain Ke Dono Ahle Sunnat Se
Hain Aur Ye Ikhtelafaat Furooi Hain, Isi Tarah
Humne Lafzi Aur Imlai Ghalatiyo Ka Zikr Kiya
Tha Jis Mein Thodi Tafseel Ye Bhi Mulahiza
                   4

Achhi Betiya’n
Farmayein Ke Kai Alfaaz Aise Hain Ke Jin Ke
Talaffuz Aur Imla Mein Ikhtelaf Paaya Jaata
Hai, Ab Yahan Bhi Kuchh Aisi Hi Soorat
Banegi Ke Hum Agarche Kisi Ek Tariqe Ki
Sihhat Ke Qaail Ho'n Lekin Uske Khilaf Bhi
Humari Isha'at Mein Maujood Hoga, Is Farq Ko
Bayaan Karna Zaroori Tha Taaki Qarayeen
Mein Se Kisi Ko Shubha Na Rahe
  Team  Abde  Mustafa  Official  Ki  Ilmi,
Tehqeeqi Aur Islahi Kitabein Aur Risale Kai
Marahil Se Guzarne Ke Baad Shaya Hote Hain
Lekin  Iske  Bawajood  In  Mein  Bhi  Aisi
Ghalatiyo Ka Paaya Jaana Mumkin Hai Lihaza
Agar Aap Unhein Paayein To Humein Zaroor
Batayein Taaki Uski Tashih Ki Ja Sake

                Sabiya Virtual Publication
                  Powered By Abde Mustafa Official





                   5
Achhi Betiya’n

Qur'an
    Tarjuma E Kanzul Imaan : "Aur Jaan
    Rakho  Ki  Tumhare  Maal  Aur
    Tumhari Aulaad Sab Fitna Hai Aur
   ALLAH Ke Paas Bada Sawaab Hai".

Hadeese Paak
  Hazrat Aboo Saed Khudri Raziyallahu Ta'ala
Anhu Se Riwayat Hai Ki Nabi E Kareem
Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Sallam Ne Farmaya
: Jis Shakhs Ki Teen Betiyan Ya Teen Bahnein
Ho Ya Do Betiyan Ya Do Bahnein Ho, Aur Vah
Unke Sath Bahut Achche Tareeqe Se Zindagi
Guzaare (Yani Unke Jo Huqooq Shariyat Ne
Muqarrar Farmaye Hain Vah Ada Kare, Unke
Sath Ahsaan Aur Behtar Sulook Ka Maamla
Kare, Unke Sath Achcha Bartao Kare) Aur
Unke Huqooq Ki Adayegi Ke  Silsile Mein
ALLAH Ta'ala Se Darta Rahe To ALLAH
Ta'ala Uski Badaulat Usko Jannat Mein Daakhil
Farmayega. (Tirmizi Shareef)



                   6
Achhi Betiya’n

Deebacha
  Islam Ke Andar Aulaad Ki Taleem Wa
Tarbiyat Par Jis Qadar Zor Diya Jata Hai Aur
Cheezon Par Uske Madde Muqaabil Bahut Km
Hai. Aulaad Ki  Tarbiyat Aur Taleem Wa
Ta'allum Ki Ahmiyat Par Hamare Bado Ne
Bahut Saari Kitaabein Likhi Hain. Qur'an E
Paak Ki Aayaat Aur Ahadees E Mubaraka Is
Ziman Mein Beshumaar Hain Lekin Is Risaala
Mein Ham Ne Khaas Kar Bachchiyon Ki
Taleem Wa  Tarbiyat Ke Liye Qur'an Aur
Ahadees Ke Mafhoom Ke Sath Sath Pahle Aqal
Wa Daanish Ke Qaul Ke Majmoo'a Ko Ikath'tha
Karne Ki Koshish Kiya Hai Taaki Maa Baap
Apni  Bachchiyon  Ki  Achchi  Tarbiyat Ka
Khyaal Rakhein. Rahi Baat Bachchiyon Ki
Azmat, Unki Qadar Wa Manzilat To Is Baat Ko
Poori Duniya Jaanti Hai Ki Islam Se Pahle Inka
Koi Maqaam Na Tha, Yah Sirf Mard Ke Liye
Khilauna Samjhi Jati Thi, Aesh Wa Ishrat Ke
Saaman Ke Alaawa Inka Koi Maqaam Wa
Mansab Na Tha. Bachchiyan Zinda Dargoor
Kar Di Jati Thi Aur Bahut Saare Mazaalim In
Par Dhaaye Jate The. Na Baap Ki Nigaah Mein
                   7

Achhi Betiya’n
Koi Azmat Thi Na Shohar Ki Nigaah Mein Koi
Waq'at, Na Bhai Ke Yahan Koi Qadar Wa
Manzilat Na  Beta Ke  Liye Yah  Qaabile
Ahtiraam. Magar ALLAH Ka Laakh Laakh
Shukr Hai Hamare Nabi ﷺ  Ki Aamad
Aamad Ne Betiyon Ko Rahmat, Bahno Ko
Barkat, Beeviyon Ko Nemat Aur Maa Ke
Qadmon Tale Jannat Bataya Fir Inki Qadar Wa
Manzilat Ka Kya Kahna Aaj Jis Ghar Mein Yah
Na Ho Vah Ghar Be Raunaq Hai. Inki Qadar Wa
Manzilat Ke Upar Sekdo Kitaabein Likhi Ja
Chuki Hain. Magar Islam Ne Jo Maqaam Wa
Mansab Ata Kiya Hai Na Pahle Kisi Ne Diya
Na Aane Wale Waqt Mein Koi De Sakta Hai.
Aaj Kal Aazaadi Ke Naam Par Inko Nanga
Nachaana Aur Aesh Wa Ishrat Ke Naam Par
Mahfooz Jagah Se Baahar Nikaal Kar Inko
Apne Hawas Ka Shikaar Banaana Yah In Par
Ahsaan Aur Inke Huqooq Ko Ada Karna Nahi
Hai Balki Inhein Lobh Laalach Dekar Dhoka
Dena Hai, Inhein Be Aabroo Karna Hai. Lihaza
Betiyon Ko Chahiye Ki Waqt Aur Haalat Ko
Pahchane Sath Hi Sath Dost Aur Dushman Ka
Parakh Bhi Apne Andar Paida Karein Taaki
Aapki Aabroo Aapka Waqaar Salaamat Rah
                   8

Achhi Betiya’n
Sake. ALLAH Paak Apne Pyaare Habeeb       یہللاُیتَعَالٰی                                          یصَلَّی
مَی           یلَّوَسَی ہی  ل وَاٰی عَلَیْہی  Ke Sadqa Wa Tufail Qaum Ki Betiyon
Ko Aqle Saleem Ata Farmaye, Aameen.
  Qaum Ki Shahzadiyon Ki Achchi Taleem
Wa Tarbiyat Ki Garaz Se Is Mukhtasar Risaala
Ko Murattab Kiya Gaya Hai. Ahle ilm Hazraat
Ki Bargaah Mein Guzaarish Hai Ki Agar Kahi
Kami Beshi Nazar Aaye To Khabar Karein
Taaki Aainda Addition Mein Shukriya Ke Sath
Islaah Ki Ja Sake.
      'Zaruri  Nahi  Ki  Beto  Se Naam
    Raushan Ho Mere Nabi Ka Chala
    Khandaan Beti Se'

        Muhammad Naseem Ahmad Qadri
 Khaadim Madarsa Faizun Nabi Noori Markazi Darool Qiraat
                                 Lohana, Janakpur Nepal





                   9
Achhi Betiya’n

Betiyon Ke Liye Zaruri Hidayat

•

Haya :
  Chhoti Bachchiyon Ko Bachpan Se Haya
Karna, Parde Mein Rahna Sikhayein, Agar
Haya Ki Chaadar O'dh Li Ya Maa Baap Ne
Udha Diya To Bachpan Se Budhaape Tak Har
Haal Mein Uski Aabroo Aur Uska Waqaar
Mahfooz Rahega  Fir Duniya Ke Sath Sath
Aakhirat Mein Bhi Kaamyabi Milegi
Insha ALLAH.
  • Chhoti Bachchiyon Ko Bachpan Hi Se
ALLAH Aur Uske Rasool   ﷺ  Ki
Muhabbat Aur Uske Ahkaam Ki  Pabandi
Sikhayein. Amal Mein Kotaahi Par ALLAH
Ta'ala Ka Khauf Dilayein.
•

Ibaadat :
  Chhoti  Bachchiyon  Mein  Ibaadat Wa
Riyaazat Ka Shauq Paida Karna Chahiye Taaki
Baalig Hone Par Ibaadat Wa Riyaazat Mein
Kotaahi Na Karein.
  • Istiqaamat : Taaki Haalat Chahe Jaise Ho
Lekin Vah Saabit Qadam Rahe Aur ALLAH
                  10

Achhi Betiya’n
Ta'ala Aur Uske Rasool   ﷺ   Par
Tavakkul (Bharosa) Karein.
•

Zohad Fidduniya :
  Yani Duniya Se Doori Aur Uski Hirs Wa
Hawas Se Dil Khaali Rahe Taaki Kisi Ke
Laalach Mein Aa Kar Apni Zindagi Tabaah Wa
Barbaad Na Karein.
•

Aakhirat Ki Muhabbat :
  Taaki Duniya Na Milne Par Gam Na Ho Aur
Aakhirat Paane Ki Khwaahish Se ALLAH Ki
Raza Par Raazi Rahe.
•

Khidmat :
  Chhoti Bachchiyon Mein Khidmat Ka Jazba
Paida Karna Chahiye. Yoo To Fitri Taur Par
Hota Hi Hai Bas Zara Aur Usko Badha De
Taaki Uske Zariye Maa Baap Ke Yahan Aur
Shaadi Ke Baad Shohar Ke Yahan Har Kisi Ke
Dil Mein Apna Ghar Bana Sake.
•

Zid :
  Chhoti Bachchiyon Ko Bachpan Hi Se Zid
Jaisi Khatarnaak Beemari Se Bachaye, Uske
Andar Zid Hargiz Na Aane De Fir Use Sabr Wa
Shukr  Ke  Sath  Sath  Khush  Rahna  Bhi
Sikhayein.

                  11

Achhi Betiya’n
•

Libaas :
  Bachchiyon Ke Kapdo Mein Bhi Yah Khyaal
Rakha Jaye Ki Jandar Ki Tasveer Na Ho, Gair
Muslimon Ke Kisi She'aar Ki Tasveer Na Ho,
Ladko Ke Mushaaba Ladki Ka Libaas Na Ho.
Yaad Rahe Ki Bachchi Khud Mukallaf Nahi
Lekin Walidain Mukallaf Hain. Lihaza Agar
Vah Gair Islami Libaas Pahnate Hain To Unse
ALLAH Ta'ala Is Ka Muakhaza Karega. Aaj
Kal Bachchiyon Ko Filmo, Dramo Wale Libaas
Pahnaye  Jate  Hain  Jo  Ki  Samaaj  Mein
Bachchiyon Ke Sath Badhti Hue Ziyaadti Wa
Darindagi Ke Asbaab Mein Se Ek Yah Bhi
Shumaar Hota  Hai.  Jab  Bachchiyon Mein
Bachpan Hi Se Is Tarah Ke Libaas Ki Aadat
Dilwayege To Badi Ho Kar Hargiz Mohazzab
Libaas Pahanne Ko Taiyar Nahi Hongi. Agar
Aap Ko Apni Bachchiyon Se Muhabbat Hai To
Unko Bachpan Hi Se Magribi Libaas Se Door
Rakhein.  Dheele  Dhaale Mohazzab  Libaas
Pahanne  Ki  Aadat  Aur Km  Se Km  Sir
Mukammal Dhaanpne Ki Aadat Daalein Taaki
Bhediyon Ke Nigaahe Bad Aur Hawas Ka
Shikaar Hone Se Bachi Rahein. Muhabbat Ka
Yah Suboot Hargiz Nahi Ki Aap  Beti Ki
                  12

Achhi Betiya’n
Parwarish Na Mukammal  Mahangi  Libaas
Pahna Kar Karte Rahein Aur Uski Yah Buri
Aadat Baad Mein Aap Ko Mushkil Mein Daalne
Ke Sath Sath Azaabe Qabr Wa Hashr Ka Sabab
Bane.
  • Bachchiyon Ko Uriya (Adhoora) Libaas
Aur Bepardagi Ke Khatraat Aur Uske Sabab Se
Bachchiyon Ke Sath Hone Wali Ziyadatiyon Se
Aagah Karte Rahein.
  • Vah Bachchiyan Jinki Umr 7 Saal Se Km
Hoti Hai Unke Liye Parda Nahi Lekin Iska
Matlab Yah Nahi Ki Unhein Nanga Rakha Jaye
Ya Doosre Logon Ke Saamne Unhein Kapde
Badalwaye Jayein Ya Gair Islami Libaas Ki
Aadat Daali Jaye. Bachchi Mein Bachpan Hi Se
Haya Paida Karne Ke Liye Use Na To Doosro
Ke Saamne Kapde Badalwaye, Na Nahlaaye,
Na Naaf Se Ghutno Tak Ke Hisse Mein Doosro
Ke Saamne Dawa Wagairah Lagaye Taaki Use
Yah Pata Ho Ki Is Jagah Ko Doosro Ke Saamne
Nanga Karna Buri Baat Hai.
  •  Daure  Haazir  Mein  Bachchiyon Ko
Fashion Karaana Ek Aam Riwaaz Ban Chuka
Hai. Auraton Ne Fitno Ko Khud Itna Badha
                  13

Achhi Betiya’n
Diya Hai Ki ALLAH Bachaye! Jab Maayein
Beauty Parlour Se Makeup Karwa Kar Aati
Hain To Vah Apni 7, 8 Saal Ki Bachchiyon Ko
Bhi Vahi Makeup Karwati Hain Ya Bachchiyan
Makeup Karaane Ki Zid Karti Hain Nateeja Yah
Ki  Paanch  Paanch Chhah Chhah  Saal Ki
Bachchiyon Ke Sath Darindagi Ke Waqiyaat
Runooma Ho Rahe Hain.  Is Liye Fitno Se
Bachne Ke Liye Bachchiyon Ko Saada Aur
Mohazzab Libaas Pahnana Chahiye.
•

Khelkood :
  Maa  Baap  Ko  Chahiye  Ki   Chhoti
Bachchiyon Ke Khel Kood Mein Bhi Nigraani
Karein. Kyunki Aaj Kal Filmo Dramo Ki
Fahash Tasveerein Km Umr Ki Bachchiyon
Mein Bhi Apna Asar Utaar Chuki Hain. Is Liye
Jahan  Tak Mumkin Ho Maa  Baap  Apni
Bachchiyon Ko Filmo Dramo Se Door Rakhne
Ke Sath Kharaab Sathiyon Ke Sath Khel Kood
Ki Izazt Hargiz Na Dein.
•

Taleem :
  Bachchiyon Ko Taleeme Qur'an Aur Adab
Ke Sath Jahan Tak Ho Sake Achchi Se Achchi
Deegar  Taleem  Bhi  Dilwaye.  Betiyon  Ki
Taleem Kis Qadar Zaruri Hai Bas Is Se Andaza
                  14

Achhi Betiya’n
Lagaya Ja Sakta Hai Ki Ahle Aqal Kahte Hain
Ki Agar Ek Aurat Taleem Yaafta Ho Gae To
Goya Ki Ek Qabeela Taleem Yaafta Ho Gaya.
Bachcho Ka Pahla Madarsa Wa School Maa Ki
God Hai. Bachche Sab Kuch Yani Adab, Aqal,
Tadabbur Sab Vahi Sikhte Hain. Lihaza Betiyon
Ki Taleem Ka Khoob Khyaal Rakhein Magar
Aisi Khalat Malat Jagah Se Mahfooz Rakhein
Jahan Buraiyan Aam Ho.
   Aisi Taleem Kis Kaam Ki Jis Se Fitna Janam
Le Aur Izzat Wa Aabroo Mahfooz Na Ho Aur
Bachchiyan Kahi Munh Dikhaane Ke Qaabil Na
Ho. Uriyaani, Fahashgoe, Badkaariyan Unke
Zehan Wa Dimaag Mein Aaye To Aisi Taleem
Aur Aisi Jagah Se Door Rakhein Warna Duniya
Wa Aakhirat Donon Mein Maa Baap Ki Pakad
Hogi Aur Sakht Se Sakht Azaab Mein Giraftaar
Honge.
•

Gam Gusaari :
  Chhoti Bachchiyon Ko Gam Gusaari Ki
Taleem Dein  Taaki Apne Maa Baap Aur
Rishtedaron Ke Gam Ko Apna Gam Samjhe
Aur Unke Gam Door Karne Aur Sabr Karne
Mein Madadgaar Ban Kar Har Dil Azeez Rahe.
  • Maa Baap Ko Chahiye Ki Bachchiyon Ke
                  15

Achhi Betiya’n
Saamne Kisi Tarah Ki Be Hayai Ki Baat Ya
Kaam Na Kare. Maslan Fahashgoe (Buri Baat
Bolna) Gaali Galoch, Jhagda Ladai Na Kare. Is
Liye Ki Aisa Karne Se Aap Ki Tarbiyat Be Asar
Hogi Aur Bachchiyon Mein Yah Aadat Ba
Aasaani Jald Aa Jane Ka Khatra Hai.
  • Maa Baap Ko Chahiye Ki Apni Bachchiyon
Ke Saamne Ek Doosre Ko Taana Na De Aur Ek
Doosre Ko Zaleel Na Kare Balki Ek Doosre Ki
Izzat Wa Qadar Kare Taaki Bachchiyon Ki
Nigaah Mein Maa Baap Ki Azmat Barqaraar
Rahe Aur Unki Tarbiyat Achchi Se Achchi Ho
Sake.
  • Maa Baap Ko Chahiye Ki Apne Kirdaar Ko
Bachchiyon Ke Saamne Bahut Paak Aur Suthra
Rakhe Is Se Aap Ki Bachchiyon Ke Kirdaar Bhi
Aala (Buland) Honge.
•

Ghareloo Kaam :
  Maa  Baap  Ko  Chahiye  Ki   Chhoti
Bachchiyon Se Ghar Ke Kaamo Mein Madad
Lein Aur Bachchiyon Ko Bhi Chahiye Ki Ghar
Ke Kaamo Mein Apni Maa Ka Hath Bataye
Taaki Ghareloo Kaam Kaaj Ki Aadat Bane.
  • Maa Baap Ki Baat Khoob Tavajjo Se Sune
                  16

Achhi Betiya’n
Aur Kisi Qism Ka Maamla Ho To Maa Baap Ke
Siwa Kisi Ko Maloom Na Hone De.

Badi Bachchiyon Ke Liye Khaas Hidayat :-
  • Badi Bachchiyan Apna Khoob Khyaal
Rakhein Yani Saaf Suthri Rahein, Kapda Maila
Kuchaila Na  Pahnein,  Baal  Sanwaar  Kar
Rakhein Aur Deegar Tareeqe Se Bhi Safai
Suthrai Ka Khyaal Rakhein. Is Se Maa Baap
Khush Hote Hain Aur Rahan Sahan Mein
Waqaar Paida Karein Is Se Khandaan Mein Aur
Rishtedaron Mein Uski Izzat Badhti Hai Aur
Shaadi Ke Paigaam Mein Bhi Dushwariyan
Nahi  Hoti Aur Har  Izzatdaar Shakhs  Aisi
Bachchiyon Ko Apne Ghar Ki Zeenat Bana Kar
Khushi Mahsoos Karte Hain.
  • Badi Bachchiyon Ko Chahiye Ki Maa Baap
Ke Sath Sirf Sach Bole. Jhoot Kabhi Na Bole
Taaki Anjaane Mein Dosto Yani Saheliyon Ke
Bahkaawe Mein Koi Galat Kaam Ho Jaye Ya
Galat Baat Ho Jaye To Maa Baap Uska Behtar
Hal Nikaal Sakein. Badi Bachchiyan Is Baat Ka
Khaas Khyaal Rakhein Ki Maa Baap Se Badh
Kar Duniya Mein Koi Bhi Aap Ka Sachcha
Hamdard Nahi Ho Sakta Balki Tajarba Hai Ki
                  17

Achhi Betiya’n
Maa Baap Beto Se Bhi Zyada Betiyon Ke
Hamdard Hote Hain Lihaza Maamla Chahe
Kuch Bhi Ho Aap Unke Sath Sirf Sach Bole
Agarche Unki Taraf Se Galati Par Mamooli
Saza Ka Bhi Imkaan Ho, Unki Bar Waqt Ki
Tambeeh Duniya Ki Ruswai Aur Aakhirat Ke
Azaab Se Bachayegi Insha ALLAH.
  • Badi Bachchiyan Maa Baap Ki Qadar Wa
Izzat Aur Unki Tazeem Wa Tauqeer Har Haal
Mein Baja Laayein Taaki Shaadi Ke Baad Maa
Baap Ke Sath Sath Apne Shohar Aur Unke Maa
Baap Aur Deegar Ghar Ke Afraad Ki Tazeem
Wa Tauqeer Karke Un Sab Ki Nigaah Mein
Apni Qadar Wa Manzilat Hamesha Badhaati
Rahein.
  • Badi Bachchiyan Tamam Kaamo Par Apne
Maa Baap Ko Tarjeeh Dein Aur Unke Hukm Ko
ALLAH Wa Rasool Ke Hukm Ke Baad Har
Hukm Par Muqaddam Jaane Aur Shaadi Ke
Baad Apne Shohar Ke Hukm Ko Saare Hukm
Par Tarjeeh Dein Taaki Is Aadat Se Maa Baap
Ki Aankho Ka Taara Bani Rahein Aur Shaadi
Ke Baad Shohar Ke Dil Ki Malka Bani Rahein.


                  18

Achhi Betiya’n
•

Zubaan Daraazi :
  Badi Bachchiyon Ko Chahiye Ki Ghar Mein
Apni Maa Aur Bhai Bahno Aur Deegar Logon
Se Zubaan Daraazi Hargiz Na Karein Choonki
Zubaan Daraazi Tamam Fitno Ki Jad Hai Aur
Zubaan Daraazi Se Insaan Aksar Zaleel Wa
Ruswa Hota Rahta Hai Aur Yahi Buri Aadat
Aksar Bachchiyon Ko Shaadi Ke Baad Shohar
Aur Unke Ghar Walo Se Judai Ka Sabab Banti
Hai. Yah Khabees Aadat Agar Aap Nahi
Chhodti Hain To Talaaq Jaisi Naubat Aa Jati
Hai Jo Aap Ki Zindagi Ke Liye Maut Se
Badattar Paigaam Laati Hai Fir Bachchiyon Ka
Poora  Khandaan  Aur  Uske  Shohar  Ka
Khandaan Maidane Jung Ke Sipaahi Bante Hain
Aur  Maamla  Court  Tak  Pahunchta  Hai,
Walidain (Maa Baap) Aur Bhai Jel Tak Ki
Musibat Jhelte Hain Aur  Zillat Wa Ruswai
Donon Khandaan Ka Muqaddar Ban Jata Hai.
Lihaza Aap Ki Narm Mizaaji Aur Zubaan
Daraazi Na  Karna Un Tamam  Fitno Ke
Darwaaze Ko Hamesha Ke Liye Band Kar
Sakta Hai.
•

Sakht Mizaaji :
  Badi Bachchiyon Ko Chahiye Ki Apni Maa
                  19

Achhi Betiya’n
Ke Sath Aur Ghar Ke Deegar Afraad Ke Sath
Sakht Mizaaji Na Dikhaaye, Yah Buri Khaslat
Maa Baap Ke Ghar Mein Aur Shaadi Ke Baad
Shohar Ke Ghar Mein Unhein Akela Kar Deta
Hai. Log Aisi Bachchiyon Se Door Hone Lagte
Hain Aur Unke Sehat Ke Liye Bhi Nuqsaan Deh
Saabit Hota Hai Aur Husn Ke Nikhaar Ko Bhi
Yaksar Khatm Kar Deta Hai.

Tambeeh :-
  Haan! Bachchiyon Ko Is Baat Ka Khyaal
Rakhna  Chahiye  Ki Maa  Baap  Ki  Gair
Maujoodgi Mein Apne Ghar Walo Ke Alaawa
Doosre Ke Liye Sakht Mizaaji Pesh Karein Aur
Shaadi Ke Baad Shohar Ke Ghar Wale Aur
Khaas Rishtedaron Ke Alaawa Bazaahir Sakht
Mizaaji Zaahir Karein Ki Koi Galat Baat Ya
Galat Kaam Ki Ummeed Un Se Na Rakhe Balki
Betiyan Apne Maa Baap Aur Shohar Aur Unke
Maa Baap Ke Alaawa Doosre Ke Liye Misle
Sooraj Ban Kar Rahein Ki Koi Galat Nigaah Se
Use Dekhne Ki Himmat Na Kare Aur Uski
Haibat (Dar) Se Us Ki Taraf Kisi Gair Ki
Nigaah Na Uthe.
•

Farmaish :
  Badi Bachchiyon Ko Chahiye Ki Farmaish
                  20

Achhi Betiya’n
Ki Aadat Apne Control Mein Rakhein Balki Na
Ke Barabar Apne Andar Aane Dein. Tajarba
Hai Ki Maa Baap Uski Zaruraton Ka Khyaal
Rakhte Hi Hain, Farmaish Ki Faraawaani Ghar
Walo Ki Nigaah Mein Aur Shaadi Ke Baad
Shohar Ki Nigaah Mein Be Waqaar Kar Deti
Hai Lihaza Beja (Bewajah) Farmaish Se Apne
Aapko Mahfooz Rakhein.
•

Gussa :
  Badi Bachchiyon Ko Chahiye Ki Gussa Kisi
Bhi Maamla Mein Hargiz Na Karein Kyunki
Ahle Aqal Kahte Hain Ki Gussa Ki Ibtida Aqal
Ka Khatm Hona Hai Aur Intiha Hamesha Ki
Sharmindagi Par Hai.
  • Badi Bachchiyon Ko Chahiye Ki Apne Maa
Baap Bhai Bahan Ko Chhote Chhote Tohfe Deti
Rahein Is Se Maa Baap Ka Dil Khush Hota Hai
Aur Is Aadat Ko Apne Andar Barqaraar Rakh
Kar Shaadi Ke Baad Apne Shohar Ko Bhi
Chhote Chhote Gift Deti Rahein Aur Unke Ghar
Ke Afraad Ko Bhi Unke Maraatib Ke Lihaaz Se
Aur Apni Haisiyat Ke Aitebaar Se Chhote
Chhote Tohfa Deti Rahein Taaki Ghar Walo
